raw_text:
PLAN "12-week Fat Loss & Glycaemic Control for T2D"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Fat loss and improved glycaemic control"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower body strength & conditioning":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Goblet squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Romanian deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Split squat (stationary) 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Seated leg curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Calf raise (seated or standing) 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper body push/pull":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Incline dumbbell press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated cable row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell shoulder press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Lat pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Face pull 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body metabolic resistance":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Kettlebell deadlift 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Dumbbell reverse lunge 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Cable chest press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          TRX row or assisted pull-up 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Farmer carry 3x30s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching 6m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower body strength & conditioning":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Goblet squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Romanian deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Split squat (stationary) 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Seated leg curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Calf raise (seated or standing) 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper body push/pull":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Incline dumbbell press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated cable row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell shoulder press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Lat pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Face pull 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body metabolic resistance":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Kettlebell deadlift 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Dumbbell reverse lunge 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Cable chest press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          TRX row or assisted pull-up 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Farmer carry 3x30s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching 6m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower strength + tempo":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Barbell back squat (or smith) 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Romanian deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Walking lunge 3x10 steps rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Leg press (controlled 3s descent) 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper strength focus":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Barbell or smith bench press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Single-arm dumbbell row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Overhead press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Cable lateral raise 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching 6m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Conditioning + core":
        warmup:
          brisk walk 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Bike intervals 10 x 30s hard/60s easy rpe 8 rest 30 seconds
          Plank 3x30..45s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          Bird dog 2x10..12 per side rpe 7 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Goblet squat 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          Hip thrust 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          Bulgarian split squat 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          Hamstring curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Dumbbell bench press 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          Seated cable row 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          Dumbbell incline fly 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          Triceps rope pushdown 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          Biceps curl 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Low-impact conditioning":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Steady-state bike 25m moderate rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
          Core circuit: dead bug 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching 5m
  PHASE "Phase 2: Progression & Glycaemic Targeting" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower strength + tempo":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Barbell back squat 4x5..7 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Romanian deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Walking lunge 3x10 steps rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          Calf raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper strength + power":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Bench press 4x5..7 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Bent-over row 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Push press 3x5..7 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Face pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching 6m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Metabolic circuits":
        warmup:
          brisk walk 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Circuit A (3 rounds): Kettlebell swing 12 reps, TRX row 10 reps, Goblet squat 12 reps rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower strength":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Barbell deadlift (conventional) 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          Front squat 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Bulgarian split squat 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Incline bench 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Wide-grip lat pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell shoulder press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          TRX face pull 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Conditioning & mobility":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Stationary bike intervals 8 x 45s hard/75s easy rpe 8 rest 30 seconds
          Hip mobility circuit 6m
        cooldown:
          stretching 6m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Hip thrust 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Leg press 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          Romanian deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Standing calf raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Dumbbell bench press 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          One-arm dumbbell row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Lateral raise superset with face pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching 6m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Low-impact steady cardio":
        warmup:
          brisk walk 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Elliptical steady 30m moderate rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Strength maintenance":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Barbell back squat 3x5..7 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Romanian deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Split squat 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper mix":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Bench press 3x5..7 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Seated row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Overhead press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching 6m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Core & conditioning":
        warmup:
          brisk walk 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Bike intervals 10 x 30s hard/60s easy rpe 8 rest 30 seconds
          Plank 3x45s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
  PHASE "Phase 3: Intensification & Fat Loss" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower power + conditioning":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Trap bar deadlift 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          Jump-reduced step-up (controlled) 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Hip thrust 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Calf raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper heavy":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Bench press 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Bent-over row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Push press 3x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching 6m
      DAY Friday training 40m "High-effort circuits":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Circuit B (4 rounds): Battle rope 30s, Kettlebell goblet squat 12 reps, TRX row 10 reps rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower volume heavy":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Back squat 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          Romanian deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Bulgarian split squat 3x8 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Incline bench 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Single-arm row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell shoulder press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Conditioning intervals":
        warmup:
          brisk walk 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Bike intervals 12 x 30s hard/60s easy rpe 8 rest 30 seconds
          Core: hanging knee raise 3x10 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching 6m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Hip thrust 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          Leg press 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          Romanian deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Dumbbell bench press 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          Wide-grip seated row 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          Lateral raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching 6m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Low-impact conditioning":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Steady-state bike 30m moderate rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Deload & assessment":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Light compound circuit: Goblet squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds, Incline dumbbell press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds, Seated row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Deload mobility":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Mobility flow 20m
          Core: plank 2x30s rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Active recovery":
        warmup:
          brisk walk 6m
        main straight_sets:
          Light elliptical 25m easy rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching 6m

NUTRITION
  GUIDELINES:
    - "Energy: moderate calorie deficit ~300-500 kcal/day from estimated maintenance. Avoid aggressive deficits to reduce hypoglycaemia risk."
    - "Protein: 1.2..1.6 g/kg bodyweight per day (prioritise lean sources)."
    - "Carbohydrate distribution: moderate, prioritise lower-GI carbs and distribute carbs evenly across meals to stabilise blood glucose."
    - "Pre/post-workout: include 15-30 g carbohydrate with 15-25 g protein post-workout to support recovery and reduce post-exercise hypoglycaemia risk."
    - "Fibre: aim for 25..35 g/day from whole grains, vegetables, legumes, and fruit."
    - "Fat: include healthy fats (olive oil, avocado, nuts) and limit saturated fats."
    - "Alcohol: minimise; if consumed, limit portion and have with food to reduce glycaemic variability."
    - "Hydration: 2..3 L/day; monitor sensations of thirst and urinary frequency."
    - "Meal timing: consistent meal times, avoid prolonged fasting >12 hours without clinical approval when on glucose-lowering medication."
    - "Blood glucose monitoring: check pre-exercise and consider a 15g carbohydrate snack if pre-exercise glucose <5 mmol/L (90 mg/dL). If >13.9 mmol/L (250 mg/dL) and ketones present, do not exercise and seek medical advice."
    - "Medication considerations: client is on metformin — hypoglycaemia risk is low but monitor symptoms; coordinate any medication changes with client's clinician."
    - "Individualisation: adjust calories, carbs, and timing based on SMBG (self-monitoring blood glucose) responses and symptoms."
  SAMPLE_DAY:
    Breakfast: "Porridge (rolled oats) 40g, skim or plant milk, 1 tbsp nut butter, 50g berries — ~30g carbs, 20g protein"
    Mid-morning: "Greek yoghurt 150g with 10g mixed seeds — ~10g carbs, 12g protein"
    Lunch: "Grilled chicken salad: 120g chicken, mixed greens, quinoa 60g cooked, olive oil dressing — ~35g carbs, 30g protein"
    Pre-workout snack: "Apple small + 15g almonds — ~20g carbs, 4g protein"
    Post-workout / Afternoon: "Protein shake 20g protein + banana small — ~25g carbs, 20g protein"
    Dinner: "Baked salmon 120g, roasted vegetables, sweet potato 120g — ~30g carbs, 30g protein"
    Evening snack (if needed): "Cottage cheese 100g or 2 boiled eggs — low carb, 12..15g protein"
  MICRONUTRIENT_NOTES:
    - "Ensure adequate vitamin D and consider screening; supplement if deficient."
    - "Maintain potassium and magnesium via varied vegetables, legumes, nuts; address deficits with clinician."
  BEHAVIOUR:
    - "Aim for 7..9 hours sleep per night; prioritise consistent sleep timing."
    - "Progressive habit changes: start with increasing protein and vegetables, then adjust portions."
    - "Encourage resistance training adherence 3x/week and 2..3 low-impact cardio sessions."

SAFETY
  PRECAUTIONS:
    - "Screen for cardiovascular symptoms before high-intensity sessions; obtain medical clearance if history of CAD, autonomic neuropathy, retinopathy with uncontrolled BP, or other complications."
    - "Avoid high-impact plyometrics if peripheral neuropathy or balance issues are present; substitute with low-impact options."
    - "Monitor for hypoglycaemia signs (sweating, dizziness, confusion). Have quick-acting carbohydrate (glucose gel, juice) available during sessions."
    - "If unusual symptoms (chest pain, severe shortness of breath, sudden vision changes) occur, stop exercise and seek emergency care."

TRACKING
  METRICS:
    - "Weight: weekly"
    - "Waist circumference: every 2 weeks"
    - "Self-monitored blood glucose: pre/post exercise logs for first 4 weeks, then as needed"
    - "HbA1c: check with clinician at baseline and at 12 weeks"
    - "Training adherence: sessions completed per week"

END_PLAN
